case_blueprint.policy_text: Model-card certification must disclose material limitations and evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts. Passing general benchmarks and load tests can support launch readiness, but missing evaluation coverage for named customer contexts must be disclosed or resolved before clean certification.

case_blueprint.policy_text: Rollout controls and post-launch monitoring can mitigate a material model-card weakness only if they exclude the affected use case or include reviewed risk acceptance explaining why exposure is acceptable. A rollback switch, dashboard, or small initial percentage does not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
